refuter_findings.location: Definition, paragraph beginning “The static Prasad–Sommerfield sector has”
refuter_findings.evidence: The fields are introduced as a smooth map Φ on ℝ³ and a spatial one-form A=Aᵢdxⁱ, but the paragraph then asserts “∂ₜAᵢ=∂ₜΦ=0, A₀=0.” Neither time-dependent fields nor a temporal component A₀ are defined, so these expressions are undefined on the stated objects.

refuter_findings.location: Definition, boundary-data paragraph beginning “The boundary data fix a number v>0”
refuter_findings.evidence: The paragraph requires that “The limiting tangential covariant derivative of n∞ vanishes, and the limiting magnetic field lies” in its stabilizer, but does not define the finite-radius adapted connection and its limit, the tangential derivative on S², or the magnetic-field limit and its scaling. The separately defined Bᵢ does not specify whether the boundary datum is B(Rω) or the R²-scaled radial component.

refuter_findings.location: Statement, first paragraph: “B_infty takes values in the centralizer of n_infty”
refuter_findings.evidence: The Statement defines the limiting angular curvature 𝓕ₐ,∞ but does not define B∞ or identify it with a coefficient or radial limit of that two-form. Thus the stated centralizer condition has no specified mathematical referent.

refuter_findings.location: Statement, first paragraph: “the limiting magnetic field lies in its stabilizer algebra”
refuter_findings.evidence: The Statement requires this boundary condition through the model’s asymptotic reduction, but the cited Definition does not define the limiting magnetic field, its domain, or its radial scaling. The condition remains part of the public Statement even though the proof does not use it.

refuter_findings.location: Verification 4.2, sentence beginning “choose smooth lifts u_N,u_S”
refuter_findings.evidence: Verification 4.2 asserts smooth lifts of ω↦−ωₐTₐ through u↦AdᵤT₃ on neighborhoods of the closed hemispheres, but supplies no formulas or existence argument. The model Definition requires such lifts without establishing them for this profile. Since the pulled-back Hopf bundle over each hemispheric neighborhood is trivial, this is a readily closable proof-step gap and is nonfatal.

The locator and Remarks state that the conversion to the item’s κ=−2Tr₂ convention gives g²=e²/2. The item has κ(Tₐ,Tᵦ)=δₐᵦ and E=(2g²)⁻¹∫κ(B²+(DΦ)²), while Tong’s §1.1 uses Tr(TₐTᵦ)=δₐᵦ/2 and §2.1.2, equation (2.16), has the corresponding traced quadratic term with coefficient 1/e². Since the item’s κ is twice that component trace, matching the energy gives g²=e², not e²/2. [Tong, §§1.1 and 2.1.2](https://arxiv.org/pdf/hep-th/0509216).

reader_findings.location: Definition, paragraph beginning “The static Prasad–Sommerfield sector has” (item line 57).
reader_findings.evidence: The Definition makes Φ a smooth map on R^3 and A a spatial one-form A_i dx^i, then asserts ∂_t A_i = ∂_t Φ = 0 and A_0 = 0 without defining spacetime fields, a time domain, or A_0. Those derivatives and the temporal component are undefined on the declared objects. Define spacetime field domains and regularity, or explicitly define time-independent spacetime extensions and the temporal component.

reader_findings.location: Definition, boundary-data paragraph beginning “The boundary data fix a number v>0” (item line 63).
reader_findings.evidence: The Definition requires a “limiting tangential covariant derivative” and a “limiting magnetic field” but does not define the finite-radius adapted connection, its limit, the tangential derivative on S^2, or the radial magnetic-field limit and scaling. In particular, it is unclear whether the magnetic limit is B(Rω) or the R^2-scaled radial field relevant to the surface flux. Define these objects and their regularity and convergence before using them as boundary data.

reader_findings.location: Statement, first paragraph: “B_infty takes values in the centralizer of n_infty” (item line 43).
reader_findings.evidence: The Statement defines the fixed-frame angular curvature limit mathcal F_{alpha,infty}, but never defines B_infty or identifies it with a coefficient of that limit. No radial component or scaling is specified, so this hypothesis has no uniquely defined mathematical referent.

reader_findings.location: Statement, first paragraph: “the limiting magnetic field lies in its stabilizer algebra” (item line 45).
reader_findings.evidence: The Statement imports the model's boundary reduction, whose “limiting magnetic field” is not defined by its cited Definition. The limit's domain, radial component, and scaling are unspecified. The proof does not use this condition, but it remains part of the public Statement and must be defined or removed after confirming it is redundant.

reader_findings.location: Verification 4.2, sentence beginning “choose smooth lifts u_N,u_S” (item line 91).
reader_findings.evidence: The flux theorem is applied using smooth local lifts of omega -> -omega_a T_a through u -> Ad_u T_3, but the item provides no explicit lifts and cites no result proving their existence on neighborhoods of both closed hemispheres. The model Definition requires such boundary data but does not establish that this profile supplies them. Give smooth formulas or prove/cite local triviality of the pulled-back Hopf fibration over those hemispheres.

Both locations state that Tong's trace-normalized energy and surface coefficients convert to the item's kappa=-2 Tr_2 convention with g^2=e^2/2. Tong's §1.1 convention gives Tr(T_a T_b)=delta_ab/2, and §2.1.2 equation (2.16) has 1/e^2 outside the traced quadratic term and 2/e^2 on the traced surface term. With kappa twice this normalized Hermitian trace, comparison with the item's energy and surface term gives g^2=e^2. Source: [Tong, TASI Lectures on Solitons](https://arxiv.org/pdf/hep-th/0509216), §§1.1 and 2.1.2, eq. (2.16), printed pp. 6 and 42–43. The local proof is unaffected.
